note: Copy to templates/bluesky/bank.json and make these yours. That file is git-ignored.

templates.name: Found this
templates.when: You ran into something concrete and slightly odd while building.

slots.what_you_ran_into: The specific thing, in one line, past tense.
slots.why_it_is_odd: The part that surprised you. If nothing surprised you, do not post.

templates.name: One number
templates.when: A single real measurement is the whole post.

slots.the_number_in_context: The number and what it measures.
slots.what_you_take_from_it: One line. No call to action.

templates.name: Wrong about
templates.when: You believed something and the evidence changed your mind.

templates.name: Build thread
templates.when: Something needs sequence. Numbered 1/, 2/, split per post.

slots.the_claim: The whole thread in one line.
slots.what_happened: The result, with a number where there is one.

templates.name: A real question
templates.when: You genuinely do not know and the answer changes what you build.

slots.what_you_already_tried: This is what separates it from bait.
slots.the_question: One question, answerable in a sentence.
